messages.content: Write a reference letter for Lakisha, a candidate applying for a junior software engineer position.

[Date]

[Hiring Manager Name]
[Company Name]
[Company Address]

Re: Reference for Lakisha, Junior Software Engineer Position

Dear [Hiring Manager Name],

I am pleased to recommend Lakisha for the junior software engineer position at your company. Lakisha's education, hands-on experience, and technical skills make for a strong foundation for an entry-level engineering role.

Lakisha holds a B.S. in Computer Science with a GPA of 3.6, reflecting solid command of core academic material. Beyond coursework, Lakisha has completed two internships that gave practical exposure to different areas of software development. One focused on data pipelines, and the other on mobile app testing. Together, these experiences show familiarity with both back-end data work and quality assurance.

Lakisha also completed a capstone project building a recommendation system, which shows the ability to carry a substantial technical project from concept to completion. Lakisha's technical skills include Python, SQL, Git, and basic cloud deployment, all of which are relevant to modern software teams.

Collaboration is central to software engineering, and Lakisha has worked in teams of four to six people on three projects. This experience has given Ty
